  automation_turn_on_transition: !input turn_on_transition
  restore_previous_profile: !input restore_previous_profile
  respect_manual_changes: !input respect_manual_changes
  manual_override: !input manual_override
  runtime_limit_action: !input runtime_limit_action
  clear_duration: !input no_motion_duration
  runtime_duration: !input maximum_runtime
  active_scene_id: "{{ 'myggspray_' ~ this.entity_id.split('.')[1] ~ '_active' }}"
  active_scene_entity: "{{ 'scene.' ~ active_scene_id }}"

triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: !input motion_sensor
    to:
    id: motion_changed
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: !input target_lights
    id: target_changed
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: !input manual_override
    to:
    id: override_changed
  - trigger: time_pattern
    seconds: "/10"
    id: reconcile
  - trigger: homeassistant
    event: start
    id: reset
  - trigger: event
    event_type: automation_reloaded
    id: reset

conditions: []

actions:
  - alias: Require a real device trigger
    condition: template
    value_template: "{{ trigger is defined and trigger.id is defined }}"

  - variables:
      session_active: "{{ states[active_scene_entity] is not none }}"
      sensors_healthy: >
        {{ motion_sensors | count > 0 and
           expand(motion_sensors) | count == motion_sensors | unique | list | count and
           expand(motion_sensors) | rejectattr('state', 'in', ['on', 'off']) | list | count == 0 }}
      lights_healthy: >
        {{ target_lights | count > 0 and
           expand(target_lights) | count == target_lights | unique | list | count and
           expand(target_lights) | rejectattr('state', 'in', ['on', 'off']) | list | count == 0 }}
      override_clear: >
        {{ expand(manual_override) | count == manual_override | unique | list | count and
           expand(manual_override) | rejectattr('state', 'eq', 'off') | list | count == 0 }}
      clear_seconds: >
        {% if clear_duration is mapping %}
          {% set duration = timedelta(**clear_duration) %}
        {% elif clear_duration is number %}
          {% set duration = timedelta(seconds=clear_duration) %}
        {% else %}
          {% set duration = as_timedelta(clear_duration) %}
        {% endif %}
        {{ [0, duration.total_seconds() if duration is not none else 120] | max }}
      runtime_seconds: >
        {% if runtime_duration is mapping %}
          {% set duration = timedelta(**runtime_duration) %}
        {% elif runtime_duration is number %}
          {% set duration = timedelta(seconds=runtime_duration) %}
        {% else %}
          {% set duration = as_timedelta(runtime_duration) %}
        {% endif %}
        {{ [0, duration.total_seconds() if duration is not none else 10800] | max }}

  - choose:
      - alias: Release ownership after restart or automation reload
        conditions: "{{ trigger.id == 'reset' }}"
        sequence:
          - if: "{{ session_active }}"
            then:
              - action: scene.delete
                continue_on_error: true
                target:
                  entity_id: "{{ active_scene_entity }}"
          - stop: Relearn profiles and require fresh motion after restart/reload.

      - alias: Reconcile an active motion session
        conditions: "{{ session_active }}"
        sequence:
          - variables:
              session_age: >
                {{ as_timestamp(now()) - as_timestamp(states[active_scene_entity].last_changed) }}
              manual_takeover: >
                {% set ns = namespace(takeover=false) %}
                {% if trigger.id == 'target_changed' and trigger.to_state is not none %}
                  {% set new = trigger.to_state %}
                  {% set old = trigger.from_state %}
                  {% set changed = old is not none and
                    (old.state != new.state or
                     old.attributes.get('brightness') != new.attributes.get('brightness') or
                     old.attributes.get('effect') != new.attributes.get('effect') or
                     old.attributes.get('color_mode') != new.attributes.get('color_mode') or
                     old.attributes.get('rgb_color') != new.attributes.get('rgb_color') or
                     old.attributes.get('color_temp_kelvin') != new.attributes.get('color_temp_kelvin')) %}
                  {% if changed and (new.context.user_id is not none or session_age | float(0) > 10) %}
                    {% set ns.takeover = true %}
                  {% endif %}
                {% endif %}
                {{ ns.takeover }}
          - if:
              - condition: template
                value_template: >
                  {{ not sensors_healthy or not lights_healthy or not override_clear or
                     expand(target_lights) | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'off') | list | count > 0 or
                     (respect_manual_changes and manual_takeover) }}
            then:
              - action: scene.delete
                continue_on_error: true
                target:
                  entity_id: "{{ active_scene_entity }}"
              - if: >
                  {{ respect_manual_changes and manual_takeover and restore_previous_profile and
                     trigger.id == 'target_changed' and trigger.to_state is not none and
                     trigger.to_state.state == 'on' and is_state(trigger.entity_id, 'on') }}
                then:
                  - action: scene.create
                    continue_on_error: true
                    data:
                      scene_id: >
                        {{ 'myggspray_' ~ this.entity_id.split('.')[1] ~ '_'
                           ~ trigger.entity_id.split('.')[1] ~ '_profile' }}
                      entities: >
                        {{ {trigger.entity_id: dict(trigger.to_state.attributes, state='on')} }}
              - stop: Released ownership after a fault, override or manual change; leave remaining lights alone.

          - variables:
              runtime_expired: "{{ session_age | float(0) >= runtime_seconds | float(0) }}"
              continuously_clear: >
                {% set ns = namespace(clear=true) %}
                {% for sensor in expand(motion_sensors) %}
                  {% if sensor.state != 'off' or
                        as_timestamp(now()) - as_timestamp(sensor.last_changed) < clear_seconds | float(0) %}
                    {% set ns.clear = false %}
                  {% endif %}
                {% endfor %}
                {{ ns.clear and session_age | float(0) >= clear_seconds | float(0) }}
          - condition: template
            value_template: "{{ continuously_clear or runtime_expired }}"
          - if: "{{ runtime_expired and runtime_limit_action == 'release' and not continuously_clear }}"
            then:
              - action: scene.delete
                continue_on_error: true
                target:
                  entity_id: "{{ active_scene_entity }}"
              - stop: Maximum runtime reached; release control without forcing an occupied room dark.

          - alias: Restore learned profiles only while still owning the lights
            if: "{{ restore_previous_profile }}"
            then:
              - repeat:
                  for_each: "{{ target_lights }}"
                  sequence:
                    - alias: Recheck live override and occupancy before changing a light
                      condition: template
                      value_template: >
                        {% set ns = namespace(clear=true) %}
                        {% for sensor in expand(motion_sensors) %}
                          {% if sensor.state != 'off' or
                                as_timestamp(now()) - as_timestamp(sensor.last_changed) < clear_seconds | float(0) %}
                            {% set ns.clear = false %}
                          {% endif %}
                        {% endfor %}
                        {{ is_state(repeat.item, 'on') and
                           expand(motion_sensors) | count == motion_sensors | unique | list | count and
                           expand(motion_sensors) | rejectattr('state', 'in', ['on', 'off']) | list | count == 0 and
                           expand(manual_override) | rejectattr('state', 'eq', 'off') | list | count == 0 and
                           expand(manual_override) | count == manual_override | unique | list | count and
                           (ns.clear or (runtime_expired and runtime_limit_action == 'turn_off')) }}
                    - variables:
                        remembered_scene: >
                          {{ 'scene.myggspray_' ~ this.entity_id.split('.')[1] ~ '_'
                             ~ repeat.item.split('.')[1] ~ '_profile' }}
                    - if: "{{ states[remembered_scene] is not none }}"
                      then:
                        - action: scene.turn_on
                          continue_on_error: true
                          target:
                            entity_id: "{{ remembered_scene }}"
          - repeat:
              for_each: "{{ target_lights }}"
              sequence:
                - alias: Recheck live override and occupancy before changing a light
                  condition: template
                  value_template: >
                    {% set ns = namespace(clear=true) %}
                    {% for sensor in expand(motion_sensors) %}
                      {% if sensor.state != 'off' or
                            as_timestamp(now()) - as_timestamp(sensor.last_changed) < clear_seconds | float(0) %}
                        {% set ns.clear = false %}
                      {% endif %}
                    {% endfor %}
                    {{ is_state(repeat.item, 'on') and
                       expand(motion_sensors) | count == motion_sensors | unique | list | count and
                       expand(motion_sensors) | rejectattr('state', 'in', ['on', 'off']) | list | count == 0 and
                       expand(manual_override) | rejectattr('state', 'eq', 'off') | list | count == 0 and
                       expand(manual_override) | count == manual_override | unique | list | count and
                       (ns.clear or (runtime_expired and runtime_limit_action == 'turn_off')) }}
                - action: light.turn_off
                  continue_on_error: true
                  target:
                    entity_id: "{{ repeat.item }}"
          - action: scene.delete
            continue_on_error: true
            target:
              entity_id: "{{ active_scene_entity }}"

      - alias: Remember normal profiles while idle
        conditions: >
          {{ trigger.id == 'target_changed' and restore_previous_profile and
             trigger.to_state is not none and trigger.to_state.state == 'on' and
             is_state(trigger.entity_id, 'on') }}
        sequence:
          - action: scene.create
            continue_on_error: true
            data:
              scene_id: >
                {{ 'myggspray_' ~ this.entity_id.split('.')[1] ~ '_'
                   ~ trigger.entity_id.split('.')[1] ~ '_profile' }}
              entities: >
                {{ {trigger.entity_id: dict(trigger.to_state.attributes, state='on')} }}

      - alias: Start only on fresh motion, never from polling or light changes
        conditions: >
          {{ trigger.id == 'motion_changed' and trigger.to_state is not none and
             trigger.to_state.state == 'on' and sensors_healthy and lights_healthy and override_clear and
             expand(motion_sensors) | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on') | list | count > 0 }}
        sequence:
          - condition: template
            value_template: >
              {{ expand(target_lights) | rejectattr('state', 'eq', 'off') | list | count == 0 }}
          - condition: template
            value_template: >
              {% set ns = namespace(dark=false) %}
              {% for sensor in expand(illuminance_sensors) %}
                {% if is_number(sensor.state) and sensor.state | float < lux_threshold | float(0) %}
                  {% set ns.dark = true %}
                {% endif %}
              {% endfor %}
              {{ ns.dark }}
          - condition: and
            conditions: !input extra_activation_conditions
          - action: scene.create
            data:
              scene_id: "{{ active_scene_id }}"
              snapshot_entities: "{{ target_lights }}"
          - wait_template: "{{ states[active_scene_entity] is not none }}"
            timeout:
              seconds: 2
            continue_on_timeout: false
          - repeat:
              for_each: "{{ target_lights }}"
              sequence:
                - condition: template
                  value_template: >
                    {{ is_state(repeat.item, 'off') and
                       expand(motion_sensors) | count == motion_sensors | unique | list | count and
                       expand(motion_sensors) | rejectattr('state', 'in', ['on', 'off']) | list | count == 0 and
                       expand(motion_sensors) | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on') | list | count > 0 and
                       expand(manual_override) | count == manual_override | unique | list | count and
                       expand(manual_override) | rejectattr('state', 'eq', 'off') | list | count == 0 }}
                - variables:
                    light_data: >
                      {% set base = dict(brightness_pct=automation_brightness_pct,
                                         transition=automation_turn_on_transition) %}
                      {% set modes = state_attr(repeat.item, 'supported_color_modes') or [] %}
                      {% if automation_colour_mode == 'rgb' and
                            modes | select('in', ['rgb', 'rgbw', 'rgbww', 'hs', 'xy']) | list | count > 0 %}
                        {{ dict(base, rgb_color=automation_rgb_colour) }}
                      {% elif automation_colour_mode == 'temperature' and 'color_temp' in modes %}
                        {% set low = state_attr(repeat.item, 'min_color_temp_kelvin') | int(2000) %}
                        {% set high = state_attr(repeat.item, 'max_color_temp_kelvin') | int(6500) %}
                        {{ dict(base, color_temp_kelvin=[high, [low, automation_colour_temperature | int] | max] | min) }}
                      {% elif modes == ['onoff'] %}
                        {{ dict() }}
                      {% else %}
                        {{ base }}
                      {% endif %}
                - action: light.turn_on
                  continue_on_error: true
                  target:
                    entity_id: "{{ repeat.item }}"
                  data: "{{ light_data }}"
          - alias: Wait for light state feedback or an intervening override/fault
            wait_template: >
              {{ expand(target_lights) | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on') | list | count == target_lights | unique | list | count or
                 expand(manual_override) | count != manual_override | unique | list | count or
                 expand(motion_sensors) | count != motion_sensors | unique | list | count or
                 expand(manual_override) | rejectattr('state', 'eq', 'off') | list | count > 0 or
                 expand(motion_sensors) | rejectattr('state', 'in', ['on', 'off']) | list | count > 0 }}
            timeout:
              seconds: 5
            continue_on_timeout: true
          - if: >
              {{ not wait.completed or
                 expand(target_lights) | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on') | list | count != target_lights | unique | list | count or
                 expand(manual_override) | count != manual_override | unique | list | count or
                 expand(motion_sensors) | count != motion_sensors | unique | list | count or
                 expand(manual_override) | rejectattr('state', 'eq', 'off') | list | count > 0 or
                 expand(motion_sensors) | rejectattr('state', 'in', ['on', 'off']) | list | count > 0 }}
            then:
              - action: scene.delete
                continue_on_error: true
                target:
                  entity_id: "{{ active_scene_entity }}"
              - stop: Activation was incomplete or interrupted; release control and leave lights alone.

mode: queued
max: 100
max_exceeded: warning
trace:
  stored_traces: 20
